hero.about: Specialized in building robust, scalable applications using ASP.NET Core, C#, and cloud technologies. Passionate about clean code, microservices, and delivering high-quality software solutions.
hero.aboutExtended:
With over 5 years of professional experience, I architect and build full-stack enterprise applications using ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and modern frontend frameworks like React and Next.js. I thrive on solving complex business problems through clean, maintainable code and scalable system design.

My expertise spans the entire Microsoft ecosystem -- from SQL Server and PostgreSQL database design to cloud deployment with Docker. I have successfully delivered high-impact systems including a national insurance platform serving millions of Syrian citizens, reducing processing time by over 80%.

I'm passionate about microservices architecture, API design, and mentoring the next generation of developers. Whether it's optimizing database queries, or building responsive interfaces with TailwindCSS, I bring a holistic approach to every project I work on.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about my work and availability
faq.q1: What technologies do you specialize in?
faq.a1: I specialize in the .NET ecosystem including C#, ASP.NET Core, and Entity Framework Core for backend development. On the frontend, I work with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I also have experience with Flutter for mobile development and cloud deployment using Docker.
faq.q2: Are you available for freelance or contract work?
faq.a2: Yes, I am open to freelance and contract opportunities. Feel free to reach out through the contact form or email me directly to discuss your project requirements and timeline.
faq.q3: What industries have you worked in?
faq.a3: I have worked across multiple industries including insurance technology, enterprise resource planning, and education. Notable projects include a national insurance recording system and a university attendance tracking solution using QR code technology.
faq.q4: Do you offer mentorship or consulting services?
faq.a4: Yes, I currently teach at Damascus University and have mentored over 800 students. I am available for technical mentorship, code reviews, and architecture consulting for teams adopting .NET technologies.
